random_field.implementation: exact import of E01 random_field_features and exact equality to its saved typed unit vectors
random_field.interpretation: fixed information-access reference with random geometry; not random guessing or a seed distribution

source_mapping_swap.mapping: swap the two source-context state labels for both source atoms and source landmarks; leave target state actual
source_mapping_swap.interpretation: the only nonidentity source-context bijection; a descriptive mapping sensitivity, not a general permutation test or permutation p-value

uniform_additive.interpretation: fixed ordinary main-effects kernel control; equal column budget does not imply equal effective degrees of freedom

control_only_prediction: predict the unique heldout state once then broadcast exactly across all heldout drugs and doses

scorer_regression.policy: all float64 metric values compare exactly to legacy TSV parsed with float_precision=round_trip; NA pattern and categorical/integer values must match; no tolerance substitution

planned_query_contrasts: six mapping-vs-original-product, six additive-vs-original-product, random-product-vs-random-direct, control-only-vs-same-drug; pair atomic IDs before averaging
retrospective_disclosure: Original-name core results and the BiomedBERT state-conditioning risk were known before this contract. These bounded controls are retrospective sensitivities; no best alpha, weights, encoder or kernel is selected.
scope: single-study descriptive three-context LOCO controls; not independent-study replication, causal mechanism evidence, or full benchmark completion
